# Cogniheim

> Cogniheim is an early-stage, founder-led, bootstrapped software venture based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. It designs and builds web products, SaaS applications and practical digital tools. Founder: Mohamed Sameer S. Cogniheim is not yet a registered company and has no external funding.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://cogniheim.com/): what Cogniheim does, process, and FAQ
- [Products & Projects](https://cogniheim.com/products): CinemaFocus (live client site), GROS (interactive prototype), ClearBiz (in development)
- [About](https://cogniheim.com/about): story, focus areas and verified facts about the venture
- [Contact](https://cogniheim.com/contact): email info@cogniheim.com or send a message
- [Privacy](https://cogniheim.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://cogniheim.com/terms)
